recognize_zh: 這是示意圖（Panel A）而非病人資料：正常紅血球體積直方圖為單一對稱的鐘形峰，紅色箭頭與中線標示 MCV（約 90 fL），實線之間為分布寬度（RDW），虛線分別設在 60 fL 與 120 fL，用來計算小球性與大球性紅血球比例，作為判讀 TTP 病人連續直方圖的對照。
features: Schematic RBC volume histogram with frequency on the y-axis and cell volume (fL, 20-200) on the x-axis
Single symmetric bell-shaped peak centered near 90 fL, marked as the MCV
Solid vertical lines bracketing the central population, with a double-headed arrow labeled RDW
Dashed vertical lines at 60 fL and 120 fL used to quantify microcytic and macrocytic fractions
describe_en: This is a non-morphologic schematic of a normal red cell volume histogram. It shows a single, symmetric, unimodal population centered at the MCV of about 90 fL, with solid lines delimiting the central distribution used to derive the RDW. Dashed reference lines at 60 fL and 120 fL allow quantification of microcytic and macrocytic red cell fractions. It serves as the baseline against which a left-shifted fragment population (schistocytes) or a right-sided macrocytic shoulder (reticulocytes) can be recognized in the patient's serial histograms.
